citations.quote: 阿里健康那些，我怎麼敢碰啊？都沒底

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: When a commenter offered 8%+ monthly put premiums on 陌陌/老虎 (30 June 2022), the author refused ('不敢買呀！'), having just called 阿里健康-type names 都沒底 (no bottom). His filter is not premium level — he collects ~6-7%/month on Tencent/Alibaba gladly — but willingness to take delivery at the strike with full cash and no leverage. A one-off illustration, not an avoid list.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Refusing fat premiums on 沒底 (no-bottom) names: take-delivery willingness, not premium yield, selects the underlying
